```{r}
data_no_mort <- subset(imp_data, select = -c(mort_28_day))
#Lasso
x <- as.matrix(data_no_mort)
y <- imp_data$mort_28_day

lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)
best_lambda <- lasso_model$lambda.min

final_lasso_model <- glmnet(x, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda)

coef(final_lasso_model)

```
```{r}
which(final_lasso_model$beta!=0)
tmp_coeffs <- coef(final_lasso_model, s = "lambda.min")
great <- data.frame(name = tmp_coeffs@Dimnames[[1]][tmp_coeffs@i + 1], coefficient = tmp_coeffs@x)

```


```{r}
#formula taken from significant lasso
mort_28_day ~ age + echo + saps + sofa + elix_score + icu_adm_weekday + icd_chf + icd_liver + icd_copd + icd_cad + icd_stroke + icd_malignancy

formula <- as.formula(mort_28_day ~ age + echo + saps + sofa + elix_score + icu_adm_weekday + icd_chf + icd_liver + icd_copd + icd_cad + icd_stroke + icd_malignancy + weight + vent + vaso)
                      
```

```{r}
#Prediction Model
library(randomForest)
set.seed(1287)
imp_data$mort_28_day <- as.factor(imp_data$mort_28_day)

train_index <- createDataPartition(imp_data$mort_28_day, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
data_train <- imp_data[train_index, ]
data_test <- imp_data[-train_index, ]

random_forest_model <- randomForest(formula, data = data_train, importance = TRUE, ntree = 500)

predicted_probabilities_test <- predict(random_forest_model, newdata = data_test, type = "prob")
threshold <- 0.3
predicted_classes_test <- ifelse(predicted_probabilities_test[, "1"] > threshold, "1", "0")


data_test$mort_28_day <- as.factor(data_test$mort_28_day)


predicted_classes_test <- factor(predicted_classes_test, levels = levels(data_test$mort_28_day))


confusion_matrix_test <- confusionMatrix(predicted_classes_test, data_test$mort_28_day)
print(confusion_matrix_test)


accuracy_test <- confusion_matrix_test$overall['Accuracy']
print(paste("Accuracy on test set:", accuracy_test))
```

```{r}
#Direct Estimate Random Forest
set.seed(1287)

imp_data$mort_28_day <- as.factor(imp_data$mort_28_day)

split <- sample.split(imp_data$mort_28_day, SplitRatio = 0.6)
split
data_train <- subset(imp_data, split == "TRUE")
data_test <- subset(imp_data, split == "FALSE")



random_forest_model <- randomForest(formula,
                                    data = data_train, importance = TRUE, ntree = 2000)

# Predicting E[Y|X,W=w] for w in {0, 1} on the test data
data_test_treat <- data_test
data_test_treat$echo <- 1

data_test_ctrl <- data_test
data_test_ctrl$echo <- 0

muhat.treat <- predict(random_forest_model, newdata = data_test_treat, type = "prob")[, "1"]
muhat.ctrl <- predict(random_forest_model, newdata = data_test_ctrl, type = "prob")[, "1"]

ate.est <- mean(muhat.treat) - mean(muhat.ctrl)

print(ate.est)
t.test(muhat.treat, muhat.ctrl)
```

```{r}
#Bootstrapped Direct Esimtate w/ Ranom Forest
num_bootstrap <- 500  #


ate_estimates <- numeric(num_bootstrap)


for (i in 1:num_bootstrap) {

  boot_index <- sample(nrow(imp_data), replace = TRUE)
  data_boot <- imp_data[boot_index, ]
  

  train_index_boot <- createDataPartition(data_boot$mort_28_day, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
  data_train_boot <- data_boot[train_index_boot, ]
  data_test_boot <- data_boot[-train_index_boot, ]
  

  random_forest_model_boot <- randomForest(formula,
                                          data = data_train_boot, ntree = 500)
  

  data_test_treat_boot <- data_test_boot
  data_test_treat_boot$echo <- 1
  
  data_test_ctrl_boot <- data_test_boot
  data_test_ctrl_boot$echo <- 0
  
  muhat.treat_boot <- predict(random_forest_model_boot, newdata = data_test_treat_boot, type = "prob")[, "1"]
  muhat.ctrl_boot <- predict(random_forest_model_boot, newdata = data_test_ctrl_boot, type = "prob")[, "1"]
  

  ate_est_boot <- mean(muhat.treat_boot) - mean(muhat.ctrl_boot)
  

  ate_estimates[i] <- ate_est_boot
}


se_ate <- sd(ate_estimates)


ci_95 <- quantile(ate_estimates, c(0.025, 0.975))


mean_ate <- mean(ate_estimates)



cat("Mean ATE:", mean_ate, "\n")
cat("Standard error of ATE estimates:", se_ate, "\n")
cat("95% Confidence Interval for ATE:", ci_95[1], "to", ci_95[2], "\n")

```

  summarise(mean_mort_28_day = mean(mort_28_day, na.rm = TRUE))

```{r}
#Odds Ratio
log_model <- glm(formula, data = imp_data, family = binomial)
coef_summary <- summary(log_model)$coefficients
odds_ratio <- exp(coef_summary["echo", "Estimate"])
lower_ci <- exp(coef_summary["echo", "Estimate"] - 1.96 * coef_summary["echo", "Std. Error"])
upper_ci <- exp(coef_summary["echo", "Estimate"] + 1.96 * coef_summary["echo", "Std. Error"])

odds_ratio
lower_ci
upper_ci

#Odds Ratio: 0.75, (0.656, 0.857)
#EValue: (1.58 for point estimate, 1.37 worst case scenario)
```
```{r}
#Sensitivity Analysis w/ Linear Regression
library(sensemakr)
imp_data$mort_28_day <- as.character(imp_data$mort_28_day)
imp_data$mort_28_day <- as.numeric(imp_data$mort_28_day)

model_lm <- lm(formula, data = imp_data)

summary(model_lm)

sensitivity <- sensemakr(model = model_lm, 
                         # causal model
                         treatment = "echo", 
                         #treatment variable
                         benchmark_covariates = c("sofa"), 
                         # variables to bound the strength of unobs confounder
                         kd = 1:3)

plot(sensitivity)
plot(sensitivity, sensitivity.of = "t-value")
plot(sensitivity, type = "extreme")
plot(sensitivity, sensitivity.of = "t-value")
```
```{r}
#Variable Importance for Random Forest Model

set.seed(1287)

imp_data$mort_28_day <- as.factor(imp_data$mort_28_day)

train_index <- createDataPartition(imp_data$mort_28_day, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
data_train <- imp_data[train_index, ]
data_test <- imp_data[-train_index, ]


train_control <- trainControl(method = "none")
model <- train(formula,
               data = data_train,
               method = "rf",
               trControl = train_control,
               importance = TRUE,
               ntree = 2000)

# Predicting E[Y|X,W=w] for w in {0, 1} on the test data
data_test_treat <- data_test
data_test_treat$echo <- 1

data_test_ctrl <- data_test
data_test_ctrl$echo <- 0

muhat.treat <- predict(model, newdata = data_test_treat, type = "prob")[, "1"]
muhat.ctrl <- predict(model, newdata = data_test_ctrl, type = "prob")[, "1"]

ate.est <- mean(muhat.treat) - mean(muhat.ctrl)


varImp <- varImp(model)
print(varImp)


plot(varImp, main = "Variable Importance for Random Forest Model")

print(ate.est)
```
